text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Angola's council of ministers approved the creation of Angola's first private bank, Banco Africano de Investimantos, which will be launched on Thursday by Angolan president Jose Eduardos dos santos.

- Angola's parliament has approved revisions to the constitution which extends the legislative mandate for the national assembly until the next elections, which the new law said cannot happen before two years and not after four years.
- Some 1,118 police from the former rebel UNITA movement have been sent to United Nations assembly camps as part of a peace plan to end two decades of civil war.
